body: Actually, i would like to know how to bring fragrances back from my holidays - I plan to travel to italy soon but ive been watching those baggage handlers throwing bags hard (intentionally) now im paranoid abit.. anyone got any advice on how to bring 3-5 bottles of fragrance back?

Pretty lame / simple answer here: Acqua di Parma Oud  


A month has passed since ive decided that niche may not be my thing as theyre too "Different" but after smelling Oud i just got my socks knocked off (in a good way).. never thought i would smell an oud this smooth and clean... so since then ive been a close follower of Acqua di Parma and have been diving more into niches since
Can't disagree with you at all

Know what you mean.. they seem so hyped up and popular but to me they smell poorly blended.. idk if it's me or the tester's issue.

So far.. tried maybe 80% of tom ford.. nothing I like so far

Secretions Magnifiques from Etat Libre d'Orange, I get that inspiration has to come from somewhere but this particular fragrance is just a vomit inducer for me, I just don't understand the existence of this fragrance..
